title: Payroll Administrator
description:
A well-established manufacturer based in Stoke-on-Trent is looking for a part-time Payroll Administrator to join its friendly People & Culture team. Working closely with the Payroll Manager, you ll make sure every employee is paid accurately and on time.

It s a supportive environment where accuracy and service really matter, and where your work makes a real difference to colleagues across the business.

Based onsite in Stoke-on-Trent this part-time Payroll Administrator role is commutable from Newcastle-under-Lyme, Crewe, Stafford, Congleton, Leek, Stone, Biddulph and surrounding areas.

Salary: £22,400 per annum ( £28,000 FTE ) with a great list of benefits and working 30 hours a week, Mon to Fri, 9am to 3:30pm.

What you'll be doing
- Processing payroll accurately and on time, including holiday calculations, deductions and statutory payments
- Keeping payroll records up to date, from new starters and leavers to monthly clocking checks and reports
- Administering pension arrangements and helping employees and managers resolve payroll queries quickly
- Supporting the Payroll Manager through monthly deadlines and year-end, and spotting ways to make processes smoother

What you need to bring
- Experience in a payroll department within the last five years (essential)
- Hands-on use of a computerised payroll system and a good understanding of payroll legislation
- Confident Excel, Word and Outlook skills, plus GCSE Maths and English at grade 4 or above (or equivalent)
- A sharp eye for detail, strong organisation and the discretion to handle confidential information

Why you'll love this job
- Full training and support from day one, in a professional, friendly team
- A generous package including enhanced annual leave, enhanced maternity and paternity pay, company sick pay, a healthcare cash plan, life insurance and free pension advice
- Free on-site parking, casual dress, Cycle to Work, long service awards, a recognition programme and regular company events

If you take pride in getting the details right and want a payroll role with a great work-life balance, we'd love to hear from you. Apply today with your CV!

title: Recruitment Administrator
description:
Recruitment Administrator Office-based in Stoke on Trent Monday to Friday, 9:30am to 2:30pm (flexible) 15 per hour Structured hours with strong work-life balance in a busy recruitment environment

Meridian Business Support are looking to appoint a Recruitment Administrator to support day-to-day operations within a well established branch. This position plays a key part in ensuring payroll accuracy and smooth onboarding for a large candidate workforce.

As a Recruitment Administrator, you will be responsible for maintaining accurate records and delivering timely payroll processing within a fast-moving environment:
- Process weekly payroll, ensuring deadlines are consistently met
- Collate, check and verify timesheets with a high level of accuracy
- Calculate holiday pay, overtime, bonuses and adjustments using Excel and internal systems
- Maintain and update candidate records within the CRM system
- Enter new starters and ensure all personal and assignment data is recorded correctly
- Issue assignment details, contracts and relevant onboarding documentation to candidates
- Answer the phone, and responding to queries from both candidates and clients

To be successful in this Recruitment Administrator role, you will demonstrate:
- Excellent communication skills including via the phone and email
- Strong Excel skills, including confidence with calculations and data management
- Previous experience using CRM systems or recruitment databases
- Excellent attention to detail with a focus on accuracy and compliance
- Ability to manage high-volume administrative tasks and meet strict deadlines
- Experience within payroll, recruitment administration or a similar coordination role is desirable

Benefits and working environment
- 15 per hour
- Consistent weekday hours with no weekend work
- Office-based role offering structure and routine
- Supportive and collaborative team environment
- Possible Opportunity to develop within a growing recruitment business

If you are a detail-focused administrator looking for a busy and structured position where your organisational and Excel skills will be valued, this Recruitment Administrator position offers a stable and rewarding next step.

Meridian Business Support is a recruitment specialist acting on behalf of our client as an Employment Agency for this vacancy.

title: Medical Receptionist
description: Looking for something different from traditional general practice? Would you like to become a member of our Primary Care Services reception and administration team providing innovative care to our patient population as part of an outstanding CQC organisation? We are looking to appoint a highly motivated and committed Medical Receptionist to join our team working 30 hours per week. There is a requirement that additional hours are worked as needed, in agreement with management, to ensure the delivery of services between 8am and 6.30pm across all practices. As well as ability to support reception extended access provision at our Moorcroft and Holmcroft sites, one day per week until 8pm (as needed). The post will be based at Moorcroft Medical Centre and Moss Green Surgery. Responding to the needs of our expanding group of Integrated practices, successful applicants will be required to provide regular rotation within our teams at Keele Practice and Holmcroft Surgery in Stafford. Therefore the ability to drive and be adaptable to the demands of the service is a must. Band 2, £25,272 per annum based on wte (Pro rata'd for part time posts). We are a friendly and well organised team with a forward-thinking approach, working with Proud to Care Values as part of an outstanding organisation. To offer patients, clinical staff, attached and external agencies an efficient, reliable and courteous reception service and to provide administrative support to the practice in order that it may function effectively, and in accordance with practice policy on confidentiality. Customer service and communication forming an essential element of the role. To provide excellent team working skills to ensure a quality and efficient service is provided to patients and wider stakeholders. To work within the processes and protocols which allow the organisation to comply with CQC and clinical and information governance requirements. Please refer to job description for full details. Key Duties/Responsibilities Reception Services to Patients: Ensuring the smooth and efficient running of our reception area, working as part of our reception team. Acting as a first contact with the practice and being aware that you are an ambassador for our surgery. Application of registration procedure for new patients and their induction into the practice via booking of an optional new patient assessment and distribution of the practice information leaflet. Receiving patients at the desk and directing as necessary. Application procedures for temporary residents and those requiring immediately necessary treatment. Operation of the appointments system which will include booking of arrivals and negotiating suitable appointment arrangements with patients. Ensuring clinicians are made aware of patients requiring urgent assessment. Monitoring and managing the waiting area to ensure that patients are seen in a timely manner and within a safe environment. Processing patient queries appropriately and ensuring follow up. Processing and distribution of claim forms etc. Receipt and processing of medical mail, both postal and hand delivered in accordance with the protocol for processing the daily post. To understand the difference between repeat and acute prescriptions and deal with appropriately. Issuing and management of repeat prescriptions in accordance with our Repeat Prescribing Policy. To deal with patient requests for non-recurrent medication and liaise with the appropriate clinician for such requests. Operation of security protocol for stocks of prescriptions. Receiving specimens, ensuring that they are correctly labelled and identifiable and ensuring their appropriate distribution in accordance with our Health & Safety policy. Direct liaison with other services such as Pharmacies, community services etc. Sign-posting to services provided both in-house and externally. Telephone Services: Providing a telephone service, answering within four rings where ever possible. Negotiation and booking of suitable appointments with patients using our appointment booking system. Addressing queries, liaising and problem-solving for patients, and other agencies such as social services, community and secondary care services. Accepting emergency requests for appointments or visits from patients and liaising with clinician on call to ensure continuity of care.Sign-posting to appropriate services. Booking external services such as ambulance transport. Informing patients of clinician instructions and/or administrative requests or requirements. Forwarding telephone calls on to appropriate team member. Communication Systems: Frequent inspection of and acting upon or entering: Practice Message Sheets and/or EMIS practice notes. Message book instructions White board messages EMIS alert and screen messages EmailsAccessing and using external specified electronic systems required for patient day to day management. INR book entries Medical Report Logbook entries Messages distributed via individual work baskets Assisting with processing of mail in accordance with practice protocol. Timely and secure sending or receiving of faxes and initiating actions accordingly. Appropriate use of Language Line. Accepting and relaying messages to team members using approved methods of communication. Teamwork: Working together and supporting each other across the practice team. Ensuring that a general broad knowledge of all tasks is in place and requesting further support and training as gaps in knowledge are identified. Liaising with and supporting practice team members for general queries and any practice systems which are in place such as recall, target achievement etc. Contributing towards any projects or pilots that the practice may take part in. Acting upon clinical team queries and/or instructions from the clinical team. Identifying issues which need further management and making the appropriate team member aware of the need to action. Contribution towards the setting up of appropriate protocols and adhering to them Covering team absences to ensure a safe working environment and preservation of safe working systems.

title: Team Administrator
description: *Please note - due to current Immigration rules and regulations, this post is not eligible for sponsorship.* This vacancy is only open at this stage to internal employees of the following organisations within the Staffordshire and Stoke-on-Trent Integrated Care System: o North Staffordshire Combined Healthcare NHS Trust o Midlands Partnership University NHS Foundation Trust o University Hospitals of North Midlands NHS Trust, inclusive of Black Country Procurement Group and North Midlands and Cheshire Pathology Service. o Staffordshire and Stoke-on-Trent Integrated Care Board We are looking for an organised and motivated individual to join our team as a Team Administrator . This is an excellent opportunity for someone with strong communication and organisational skills who enjoys working in a fast-paced environment and providing high-quality support services. The successful candidate will provide a comprehensive administrative support service to the parent and baby team, ensuring the smooth and efficient delivery of day-to-day operations. The role will involve a variety of administrative duties to support the team and service users accessing the service. Offering administrative support to the whole perinatal and maternal mental health team. You will work as part of the multidisciplinary team to support with the administrative task and at times be the first port of contact for people accessing the service. We are looking for someone who is compassionate, approachable and responsive who can bring new and innovative ideas to the admin team. Providing and receiving routine information to inform work colleagues, patients, clients, carers, the public or other external contacts. In particular, this will involve: Responding appropriately to requests for information Act on correspondence referring to the appropriate person as required. Providing routine information to manager and colleagues,Answering routine telephone queries from patients/clients/carers/colleagues/public or other external contacts Preparation/completion of routine documents, including letters, reports, presentations and forms e.g. purchase order requisitions, photocopying, filing Handling telephone queries including full reception duties Assisting patients/clients/relatives during incidental contacts The role will require capacity to make decisions, which may require consideration of a range of options, such as: Judgements on how to deal with enquiries, patients/carers/external contacts. Prioritisingworkload. Responsible for data entry, text processing or storage of data compiled by others, utilising paper or computer based data entry systems. Understanding of a range of routine work procedures some of which may fall outside of the immediate work area. In particular this will involve an understanding of and compliance with relevant deadlines and procedures legislation, procedures, schemes.

title: Medical Administrator
description: PLEASE NOTE THIS IS A SURGERY BASED ROLE NOT A HYBRID OR REMOTE ROLE An exciting opportunity has arisen at Baddeley Green Surgery for a part-time Medical Administrator, working 25 to 30 hours per week with cover until 6:30pm for sickness and holiday absence. We are looking for someone who has experience in Primary Care who is pro-active, enthusiastic self-motivated with experience in dealing with general administration duties, general public face to face and via telephone, who has working in a previous reception or customer service role. To be responsible for undertaking a wide range of administration duties and the provision of general support to the multidisciplinary team. Duties can include but are not limited to, greeting and directing patients, effective use of the appointment system, booking appointments, referring patients, scanning and processing of information, completing basic non-opinion forms for the GP to approve and sign including Insurance Forms, Benefit Forms, PIP forms, DVLA, Gun Licenses etc and assisting patient's general enquiries as required. To act as the central point of contact for patients, the distribution of information, messages and enquiries for the clinical team, liaising with multidisciplinary team members and external agencies such as secondary care and community service providers. Attendance at the Covid 19 vaccination clinics, dealing with patient queries regarding the Covid 19 vaccinations. To provide effective high quality and responsive care appropriate and timely within a safe environment to meet the needs of our registered patients without restriction or discrimination, adhering to information governance regulations at all times. To ensure all staff both clinical and non-clinical are aware and up to date with all relevant training for their roles, to ensure safe delivery of services to patients. a. Patient recalls b. Carry out system searches as requested c. Initiating contact with and responding to, requests from patients, team members and external agencies d. Scanning and coding of patient related documentation and attaching scanned documents to patients healthcare records e. Process personal, telephone and e-requests for appointments f. Answer incoming phone calls, transferring calls or dealing with the callers request appropriately g. Action direct requests for information i.e. SAR, Insurance/Solicitors letters and DVLA forms to the appropriate personnel h. Action incoming emails/tasks as necessary in support of the secretarial team i. Manage all queries as necessary in an efficient manner j. Data input with attention to detail k. Action incoming emails and online triage when necessary l. Support reception staff making patients appointments m. Dealing with medical records regarding Social Services and Safeguarding requests n. Photocopy documentation as required o. Data entry of new and temporary registrations and relevant patient information as required p. Summarising and Input data into the patients healthcare records as necessary q. Direct requests for information i.e. SAR, insurance/solicitors letters, DVLA, PIP and Benefit forms and DVLA forms etc r. General administration duties, eg photocopying, filing, shredding etc s. Maintain a clean, tidy, effective working area at all times t. Support all clinical staff with general tasks as requested u. Dealing with patients Covid 19 Vaccination queries v. Attendance and duties required at the Covid Vaccination Clinic w. Updating and reviewing practice policies and procedures x. Searches and duties to support the Practice Manager y. Undertaking Fire Alarm Testing and Water Analysis in accordance with the Legionnaires requirements z. NHS App Ambassador
